During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]] '''stormed''' the [[Killik/Legends|Killik]]-infested [[Mensaav Military Laboratory]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] in order to search for survivors of the previous [[Attack on the Mensaav Military Laboratory|attack]]. The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] was surprised to discover the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] former teacher, and a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] named [[Parvux]] still alive, and the two Jedi fought off a renewed Killik attack led by their [[Killik Praetor|Praetor]].
